facts.value: As part of your study program in another department, you can complete certain modules at our Department of Economics, known as export modules of the Department of Economics - including optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between departments.

facts.value: You cannot register for other modules from the Department of Economics in your program at another department and also cannot earn differing credit points (CP) at the Department of Economics.
